mapper.select: SELECT ID, BATCH_NO, FILE_NAME, STATUS, TOTAL_COUNT, SUCCESS_COUNT, ERROR_MESSAGE, STARTED_AT, FINISHED_AT FROM PT_IMPORT_BATCH WHERE BATCH_NO = #{batchNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PT_IMPORT_BATCH (ID, BATCH_NO, FILE_NAME, STATUS, TOTAL_COUNT, SUCCESS_COUNT, ERROR_MESSAGE, STARTED_AT, FINISHED_AT) VALUES (#{id}, #{batchNo}, #{fileName}, #{status}, #{totalCount}, #{successCount}, #{errorMessage}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE PT_IMPORT_BATCH SET STATUS = #{status}, TOTAL_COUNT = #{totalCount}, SUCCESS_COUNT = #{successCount}, ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage}, FINISHED_AT = #{finishedAt} WHERE BATCH_NO = #{batchNo}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ID, BATCH_NO, FILE_NAME, STATUS, TOTAL_COUNT, SUCCESS_COUNT, ERROR_MESSAGE, STARTED_AT, FINISHED_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY STARTED_AT DESC, ID) AS RN FROM PT_IMPORT_BATCH ) PAGE_DATA WHERE PAGE_DATA.RN <= #{limit} ORDER BY PAGE_DATA.RN
